annotations.title: Edit a service, class or rental

description: Only for business owners signed in to Awning. Change name, description, duration, price, advance booking or cleanup time, or archive it. Confirm with the owner first; archiving cannot be undone. Use it to change a service that exists; to add a new one use owner_add_offering. Send only what changes.

archive.description: True removes the service from the page; this cannot be undone

buffer_after_min.description: Cleanup or turnaround minutes kept free after each booking

business_id.description: Which business, when the owner runs several: business_id from owner_status. Leave out when there is only one.

min_advance_hours.description: How many hours ahead a booking must be made

offering_id.description: The service to change: offerings[].offering_id from get_business or owner_status

price.description: New price in major units of the business currency, e.g. 2500

name: owner_update_offering
title: Edit a service, class or rental
